name: SculptPie
description: Fast, fully customisable pie menus for ZBrush: brushes, alphas, materials and any ZBrush button one flick away.
overview: SculptPie gives ZBrush twenty pie menus that open at your cursor on a shortcut. Fill them with brushes, alphas, materials, buttons, switches and sliders, nest them in groups and rings, and style everything in a live editor. It reads your SculptShelf brush and alpha folders, can upscale icons with AI, and exports menus together with their external brushes as one shareable zip.
